# Sammanfattning av dagens rapporter: ”Småbolagsrally”

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-10-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a wrap-up of the morning's earnings reports. Large caps barely moved: Assa Abloy and Alfa Laval were flat, Alfa Laval had strong order intake and a short order book, and Wärtsilä fell 6-7% on weak guidance. The main theme is a small-cap rally. The hosts argue that the investment boom in energy, defence and data centres is reaching small companies, which have become cheap after years of outflows. Storytel, Prevas, Hanza and Dedicare rose. Alleima kept falling after a weak report, and Tieto fell after cutting its organic growth guidance.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 STORY-B — Storytel | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Good report: adjusted profit in line with consensus, growth accelerated, new customers in Sweden; once beaten down over fears of tech giants.

#### Reasoning

The host called it a good report. Adjusted for incentive programmes (8-10 MSEK), profit matched expectations and growth accelerated this quarter. The fear that big platforms would swallow Storytel has not shown up in customer losses. Risks remain from Spotify scaling audiobooks in H2 and a possible YouTube entry.

#### Sell Triggers

- if customer losses appear as Spotify scales audiobooks
- if YouTube enters the audiobook market
- if growth slows again

> *"Bra rapport. Men ändå en uppenbar risk där, både från Youtube som vill ge sig in kanske på ljudboksmarknaden, men också Spotify"*

---

### 🟠 HANZA — Hanza | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Day's winner: organic sales +7%, profit +50%; acquisitions make the numbers harder to read.

#### Reasoning

Hanza showed clear organic sales improvement and strong profit growth. It is a 10bn-SEK small cap that fits the small-cap rally driven by the energy, defence and data-centre investment boom. The host warns that large acquisitions make the figures hard to interpret.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stalls
- if acquisition integration hurts margins

> *"organiskt så är det en tydlig tydlig omsättningsförbättring, jag tror det är 7 procent upp och sen så är det en vinstförbättring på 50 procent"*

---

### ⛔ ALLEI — Alleima | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Weak report on all lines (margin, sales, orders); down nearly 20% in two days. The host notes the selloff exceeds the ~10% target cuts.

#### Reasoning

The report was weak across operating margin, sales and order intake, and the share is still falling. The host notes the market sold off about 20% against roughly 10% price-target cuts, implying a possible overreaction. The view is mixed, so this is a weak avoid.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake recovers
- if the selloff proves an overreaction and the share rebounds

> *"Den var dålig på alla siffror, rörelsemarginal, försäljning, orderingång."*

---

### ⛔ TIETOS — Tieto | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Profit warning: organic growth guidance cut on Tech Consulting problems; down about 4%; IT consultants have not delivered for years.

#### Reasoning

Tieto issued a profit warning, cutting full-year organic growth guidance because of continued problems in Tieto Tech Consulting. The host says IT consultants have not benefited from the AI shift and have not delivered for several years. A planned divestment of about 300 MSEK of revenue may help focus.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the divestment unlocks value
- if Tech Consulting stabilises

> *"De sänkte helårsprognosen för den organiska tillväxten. på grund av fortsatta problem inom Tieto Tech Consulting."*
